amanda: Heads up — a few PR builds on main are failing: gha/integration-upgrade job errors with "decrypt: access denied" and "invalid KMS key". Seen 6 failing runs since ~15:02 UTC. @eng-infra
ryan: Looking. Can you paste a run link?
amanda: https://github.com/redwood-inference/actions/runs/12345678 — logs show KMS decrypt errors during `restore-secrets` step. Short log: `DecryptError: access denied for key projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/gha`
sahil: Did we rotate the SERVICE_TOKEN/service account yesterday? I changed the KMS mapping for infra kms -> infra-prod-kms in the vault sync job at ~14:50.
amanda: yes I rotated the platform service token as part of the quarterly rotation. I updated the token in Vault at `secret/data/ci/gha/service_token` but I forgot to update the repo Actions secret that GH reads. My bad.
ryan: That would explain decrypt: GH action runner tries to unwrap using the old KMS key mapping. Quick fix: set the repo secret from Vault. You can do locally with `gh` or update via UI. Example: `gh secret set SERVICE_TOKEN -b"$(vault kv get -field=value secret/data/ci/gha/service_token)"`
amanda: trying the gh CLI now...
amanda: (command)
```
# fetch from Vault and push to repo secrets
VAULT_ADDR=https://vault.internal.redwood
vault login -method=github token=${VAULT_TOKEN}
vault kv get -field=value secret/data/ci/gha/service_token > /tmp/gha_token
gh secret set SERVICE_TOKEN -b"$(cat /tmp/gha_token)" --repo redwood-inference/platform
```
amanda: done, secret updated in repo and in the actions environment.
devops-oncall: Nice. Recommend rerunning just the failing job to confirm. If it still fails, we should bisect whether a transpiler/upgrade change made the artifact incompatible, but first verify secret fix.
amanda: @ryan can you trigger a rerun for PR #2147 that hit the failures? Prefer a re-run of the workflow not a full PR push.
ryan: kicking rerun now.
